<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def ppos(fr):
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b' and 20<=n['pixels']<=26:
            b=n['boundary']; return (b[0][0],b[0][1])
def em(fr):
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='R':
            b=n['boundary']
            # emitter = bottom-left red block; find min row region
            rows=[p[0] for p in b]; 
            # emitter is the 5x5 block; get its top-left from boundary
            return b
print("player:", ppos(current_frame))
print("emitter boundary:", em(current_frame))
# continue down
action(['DOWN'])
print("after DOWN (expect (44,14)):", ppos(current_frame))
action(['DOWN'])
print("after DOWN (expect (50,14)):", ppos(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
